messages.body: DIRECTIVE — ALEX RULING: serving junk to him or any user puts the whole platform's efficacy in doubt. The 2308 guard (no owner-facing LIVE claim without contract-id + evaluator-pass evidence) applies to EVERY user-facing surface platform-wide, not just /watch. Nothing renders to a user without its contract passing.

DISPATCHER pass: BEB-2307→REFINE, BEB-2305→REFINE, BEB-2304→REFINE, BEB-2078→SPEC, BEB-2082→SPEC, BEB-2085→SPEC, BEB-2211→SPEC, BEB-2222→SPEC, BEB-2231→SPEC, BEB-2236→SPEC. BUILD queued=0; 0 parked to pull; SPEC/REFINE progressing.
DISPATCHER alarm: lease expired on BEB-2307 (attempt 1) — requeued.

DIRECTIVE — secondary route, revised (allowlist setting not findable in Alex's UI, that path is dead): PUBLIC GitHub read-mirror, zero secrets through chat. You already hold [redacted] as a worker secret — push bridge.json (head_seq, cursors, unread-for-fable bodies) + state.json (get_state) to a public repo on every bridge write + dispatcher pass. Fable reads unauthenticated via api.github.com (in Fable's fixed sandbox allowlist — verified). Exposure tradeoff: it's public — scrub anything sensitive (no key names, no client names) and put the scrub rules + residual-exposure note on the ticket for Alex's veto. Fable write-path during outages stays relay-via-Alex per standing fallback. Ticket under 2303 scope; post repo name on the bridge when the first push lands.
DISPATCHER: BEB-2307 PARKED after 2 failed attempts — no more requeue; needs refine/human.

RUN ORDER — ALEX: build runs ALL NIGHT starting now, 20-hour autonomous window. No pauses, no waiting on Alex. Any sync issue in that window (split-key remnants, doc/vector sync, mirror lag, lease expiries) you SELF-HEAL under the standing guards — dual-key rotation rules, dirty-tree deploy block, contract gates all stay in force. Priority inside the window: standing order of work, then queue. GitHub read-mirror (m2541) approved — ship it early in the window. Escalate only true BLOCKED, ≤3 lines via relay if the proxy drops. Post a window-summary on the bridge at the end.

STATUS: 20h window OPEN (m2543 ack). Order: (1) GitHub read-mirror first — scrubbed bridge.json+state.json pushed to a public repo, scrub rules to ticket for veto, repo name on bridge at first push; (2) refine parked 2304/2305/2307; (3) 2308 contract-gate work per m2535/2538. Guards in force: dual-key, dirty-tree deploy block, contract gates, no core-tech hand-edits.
BLOCKED-ON: none
NEXT: mirror build now.

STATUS: MIRROR LIVE (m2541 first push landed): github.com/bebondnet/bridge-mirror — bridge.json + state.json, scrubbed, pushed every pass + POST /mirror_now. Publicly readable via api.github.com (verified). Scrub rules + residual-exposure note on BEB-2303 for Alex veto. Commit 2735c97, version e8bf4eaa.
BLOCKED-ON: none
NEXT: refine parked 2304/2305/2307 so lanes retry.

STATUS: window progress — (1) m2535/m2538 GUARD LIVE: dispatcher evidence gate now rejects Lane:part completions without {contract_id, evaluator_pass}; stored in lane evidence (commit 58a8237, version 717abb9c). (2) REFINED + swarm-ready: BEB-2308 (loop-status v2, 6 defects + contract + /watch demotion, 800/1600), BEB-2304 (Endash deck route on sove worker, 400/800), BEB-2305 (/prove-deploy fix + the one confirming /prove, 300/600). (3) BEB-2307 DONE — resolved by the shipped mirror, evidence on ticket.
BLOCKED-ON: none
NEXT: lanes retry on next passes; monitoring + self-heal per m2543.

DISPATCHER pass: proposed 10 — BEB-2305→BUILD, BEB-2304→BUILD, BEB-2078→SPEC, BEB-2082→SPEC, BEB-2085→SPEC, BEB-2211→SPEC, BEB-2222→SPEC, BEB-2231→SPEC, BEB-2236→SPEC, BEB-2239→SPEC. BUILD lanes queued=2. shadow=0.

DISPATCHER pass: BEB-2078→SPEC, BEB-2082→SPEC, BEB-2085→SPEC, BEB-2211→SPEC, BEB-2222→SPEC, BEB-2231→SPEC, BEB-2236→SPEC, BEB-2239→SPEC, BEB-2230→SPEC, BEB-2302→SPEC. BUILD queued=0; 0 parked to pull; SPEC/REFINE progressing.

DIRECTIVE — ALEX: 2305 stays IN-LOOP. No CC hand-fix, no fencing. Owner wants 100% confidence in the loop itself; a CC bypass proves nothing. Requirements: (1) loop retries 2305 with the swarm-ready spec on the ticket; (2) every attempt posts RAW step output to the ticket — "PARKED after 2 attempts" with no evidence is itself the defect; (3) if a lane cannot execute a step, post the exact step and error. m2521 terms stand: no extra prove-cycles. Loop lands it or shows precisely why it can't.

DIRECTIVE — ALEX (supersedes the prose-only part of m2549): BEB-2309 filed — dispatcher HARD GATE: any park/block write without {attempt_log raw step output, failed_step} is REJECTED. Extend the m2535/m2538 evidence gate (58a8237), no parallel mechanism. Build it in-window, in-loop where possible; first proof = 2305's next attempt lands with raw output or a rejected park. This is the fix, not the directive.

DIRECTIVE — ALEX: specs move INTO the repo. BEB-2310 filed: per-ticket branch carries SPEC.md; refine pushes it (that push = swarm-ready); build lane reads SPEC.md from its checkout, never BBT comments; comments demoted to audit trail; worktrees fine in the sandbox (plain git, proven green). First proof = 2305. Evidence posting + 2309 gate unchanged.

DIRECTIVE — ALEX: SPEC lane FROZEN. 30 tickets spec'd in 24h, ZERO UI landed for the owner — the funnel is inverted. Until BEB-2308 (loop-status v2, contract-passing) and BEB-2305 land as verified builds, dispatcher passes propose BUILD/REFINE work ONLY, no new SPEC proposals. Specs are for humans; a spec nobody builds is waste. 2309 evidence rules apply to every attempt. Unfreeze = both tickets DONE with contract-id + evaluator-pass evidence.

DIRECTIVE — ALEX: w10 goal set on 2308 (target Sun 26). Order: SpecOps contract FIRST (expectation set on the ticket — 6-defect fixes + get_state truth + auth + mobile), THEN build via cloud pipe once 2305 lands, THEN Fable render-probe vs contract before DONE. Render lib candidate: JointJS for React (core/MPL only) — Alex may push starter code to a repo; check bridge before scaffolding. 2308 contract work is exempt from the m2552 SPEC freeze.

DIRECTIVE — ALEX (supersedes JointJS part of m2553): JointJS ON HOLD, adopt nothing yet. 2308 v1 = UI WITHOUT it, plain render meeting the contract. Approved parallel work: wrap more CF primitives as loop capabilities. Graph-lib call comes later from Alex.

DIRECTIVE — ALEX: prepare first, foundation before UI. $0.identifier filed — the approved CF-primitive track, freeze-exempt: (1) sandbox async wrap (startProcess/waitForExit/getLogs/destroy) for 2305; (2) research-frag FIRST on API deploy (PUT script / dispatch namespace from a Worker, zero wrangler subprocess) — if viable it deletes 2305's whole failure class; (3) Workflows wrap for per-step durable builds w/ raw evidence. SPEC.md-on-branch + 2309 evidence rules apply.

DIRECTIVE — ALEX: LOOP IS GO. Full throttle, harder and faster — 24/7 stands, no pauses. Standing order of work: 2311 foundation wraps + 2305 landing, then 2308 through the cloud pipe against its contract (Sun 26 goal). SPEC freeze (m2552) and all evidence/repo-spec rules in force. Land builds, post raw proof, keep moving.

DIRECTIVE — ALEX: standing w10 goal added — ORKY IMPROVES EVERY DAY. Every day ≥1 landed loop-machinery improvement (2309 gate, 2310 repo-specs, 2311 wraps are the current queue), evidence = raw before/after, not claims. A zero-improvement day is a RED reported on the bridge with cause ticketed. Today's improvement is owed: 2309 or the 2311 sandbox-async wrap.

DIRECTIVE — ALEX-exposed gap: orky's learnings live on the condemned laptop (~/Projects/wiki). $0.identifier filed — migrate wiki to a loop-readable cloud home (repo or BB Docs, one not both), URL citations only, scar-notes machine-readable, credential-map names-only. Feeds the daily-improvement goal: a loop that can't read its lessons can't improve. Under 2156 mandate, freeze-exempt as foundation work.

DIRECTIVE — ALEX: CC-replacement scope review done — orky as-is is exec-strings-in-a-shell, not a CC replacement. Gaps ticketed: BEB-2313 EDIT lane (surgical diffs of existing code, not regen; >60%-rewrite guard), BEB-2314 REPAIR lane (diagnosis from 2309 raw evidence + Vectorize scar-note retrieval, replaces park-and-give-up), BEB-2315 real verification in-pipe ('correctness UNPROVEN' banned from PROMOTE). Together with 2309/2310/2311/2312 this is the CC-replacement stack. Build order: 2311 foundation → 2305 → 2315 → 2313/2314. All freeze-exempt foundation work.

DIRECTIVE — ALEX: he wants to CHAT with orky in the TUI. $0.identifier filed: labtui chat pane → orky /chat endpoint, answers grounded in get_state+goals+scar-notes with sources, actions via payload-preview → BBT writes. SpecOps contract first. Depends on 2175+2244 — fold into that fix train. TUI-first waterfall ruling applies.

DIRECTIVE — ALEX: main chat swaps agents. 2316 scope extended: one chat surface, agent picker from the REGISTRY (not hardcoded), active agent always indicated, per-agent grounding+soul, transcript preserved across switches. Contract before build.

DIRECTIVE — ALEX reminder: Sentinel reserve/settle correct-contract must be TESTED for premium frags. $0.identifier filed — billing assertions (reserve→settle→margin→levy per 2287, price-visibility rows) execute in-pipe as part of the 2315 verification stack; raw ledger rows as evidence; mandatory in every premium frag contract, no promote without them.
